subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should restart-drain bypass capability remain a private core/gateway implementation detail, or become an explicit plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The PR currently makes a gateway-drain bypass callable from the public channel lifecycle SDK, which affects the restart fail-closed boundary and cannot be accepted as an incidental implementation detail.

options.title: Keep Bypass Private
options.body: Remove plugin-facing enqueueInternal or public allowDuringGatewayDrain surfaces and route trusted restart flushes through core-owned private helpers.

options.title: Promote SDK Contract
options.body: Accept the new public plugin capability only with explicit maintainer approval, docs, tests, and a security model for when plugins may bypass draining.

options.title: Pause For Persistence Direction
options.body: Defer this branch if maintainers prefer the broader SQLite/persistent recovery direction tracked by related restart message-loss work.

recommendation.title: Keep Bypass Private
recommendation.body: Remove plugin-facing enqueueInternal or public allowDuringGatewayDrain surfaces and route trusted restart flushes through core-owned private helpers.
